root_idea.summary: Attribution and affiliation: assigning a person to a lineage or associating people with one another.
root_idea.development: The evidence develops from asserting filial relationship to naming affiliated companies or groups, including the Quranic plural عِزِينَ for separate or dispersed groupings. A secondary explanation connects the group noun with mutual patience and consolation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular citation form عِزَةٌ; the sole Quran occurrence is the plural عِزِينَ.

senses.definition: A group or company; in the Quranic plural, separate or dispersed groups.
senses.usage_conditions: The attested Quranic form is the plural عِزِينَ, describing groups present in a state of dispersion. An alternative explanation connects the group name with people mutually taking patience or consolation from one another, without changing the attested group reference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assert a person's filial relationship to a particular father; intransitively, to assert one's own relationship to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive construction is used with إِلَى; an intransitive use with إِلَى or لِـ is also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assert one's own filial relationship to another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII; used with إِلَى or لِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party or company of people, especially one conceived as mutually affiliated or allied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The affiliation may be understood as based on birth or on mutual alliance; its plural forms include عِزُون, عُزُون, and عِزًى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dialectal expression invoking or acknowledging favorable inclination, such as an appeal for mercy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Dialectal; it also occurs in a saying functioning as an emphatic appeal or asseveration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named tribe of the jinn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper name referring to a particular legendary group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The assertion of a filial relationship to a particular person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive associated with the derived forms اعتزى and تعزّى.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Filial attribution is represented under عَزَاهُ.
The intransitive variant is covered by the same filial-attribution meaning.
Form VIII filial attribution is represented separately.
Covers the Quranic dispersed-group usage and the broader company sense.
Dialectal appeal or favorable-inclination expression is represented.
The substantive denoting filial attribution is represented.

cautions: The singular citation form عِزَةٌ is used for the Quranic plural عِزِينَ.
The derivation of عِزِينَ has an alternative explanation associating it with mutual patience or consolation; this is retained as a usage note rather than a separate Quranic translation sense.
